$description: Vela design tokens. THE source of truth: dist/tokens.css and the Figma library are both generated from this file. Edit here, run `npm run tokens`. Dark mode is an overlay: vela.dark.tokens.json re-points the semantic colours that change, and vela.resolver.json (DTCG Resolver module) says how the two combine. Conforms to the DTCG Format, Color and Resolver modules 2025.10; `npm run tokens:validate` checks it.

focus-ring-color.$description: One focus treatment for the whole kit.

space-25.$description: 25 exists; 50 does not. Do not interpolate the scale.

icon-16.$description: Button icons never exceed 16. 12 at tiny, 16 everywhere else.

control-height-24.$description: Button and the input family do not share a height ramp.

control-height-25.$description: Button and the input family do not share a height ramp.

radius-4.$description: The default corner for every component.

radius-full.$description: Status Indicator dots and the Toggle track only.

stroke-2.$description: Strokes that are not borders: the Button spinner arc and the selected-tab underline. Hairline borders stay 1px and need no token.

field-mark-gap.$description: Gap between a field label and its required mark. Not a step of the spacing scale, which starts at 5.

toggle-track-width.$description: Regular track. The knob travel is track width minus knob size minus twice the inset, so these four tokens move together.

toggle-knob-inset.$description: Distance from the track edge to the knob, both sizes.

control-checkbox-size.$description: Checkbox box, regular: one side of the square. Matches icon-16 so a box and a button icon sit level, but it is control geometry, not an icon.

control-checkbox-size-tiny.$description: Checkbox box, tiny, for dense tables. The same 3:4 ratio to regular as the Toggle track.

control-radio-size.$description: Radio circle diameter. One size: a radio group is read as a list, never set in a dense table cell.

control-radio-dot.$description: The dot inside a selected Radio, centred in control-radio-size.

status-dot-small.$description: Status Indicator dot, small — for dense tables.

font-weight-regular.$description: Button labels are Regular 400 at every size.

duration-instant.$description: A press landing. Below the ~85ms where a delay starts to read as lag, so contact and acknowledgement arrive together. Press-in only — the release settles at duration-base.

duration-fast.$description: Anything that answers a pointer: hover in, exits.

duration-base.$description: Anything that settles or enters: hover out, appearing.

ease-standard.$description: The only curve. Never a bare ease.

blur-materialize.$description: The spinner appearing. The only blur in the kit: motion is feedback, never decoration.
